results.title: Nikolay Drozdov. Rules of Life on Earth
results.original_title: Николай Дроздов. Правила жизни на Земле
results.overview: A life-affirming film-journey into the world of Nikolai Drozdov, which will be loved by those who grew up watching “In the Animal World” and those for whom he is the charming grandfather from the Gucci campaign.

results.title: Nikita Roy
results.overview: A woman's scepticism about the supernatural is challenged when she looks into the mysterious death of her brother and its connection to a religious cult.

results.title: Eighty-Four
results.overview: In the aftermath of Indira Gandhi's assassination, the spectre of retaliatory violence looms over the Sikh community of an Old Delhi neighbourhood.

results.title: Different Faces
results.overview: Different Faces is a short film about a couple who move from the city to the country.

results.title: Words Fly Back to the Black Earth
results.overview: A calling inhabits the blank pages, unfolding a secret writing of hers. The unseen written traces seep from the murmuring land, pushing through fragmented voices to become new forms, beings made material. Framed as a dialogue with my grandmother, this film explores an alternative form of personal writing by Chinese women in political shifts, absent and abundant. The 'blank' becomes an image, carrying a search for agency; of land transformed and of women unheard. By breaking down linguistic structures, the film opens a space for imagining, reading, and performing, allowing for emergence.

results.title: Performing
results.overview: Two high school students, different from others in personality and experience, try to figure out how they want to show up in the world.

results.title: The Players
results.overview: Summer. 1994. Emily is cast as the youngest member of an avant garde theatre production. She is immediately entranced by the bohemian lives of her fellow actors and feels like she has found a surrogate family, but as the lines between artistic and personal relationships blur, Emily becomes trapped in the complex power dynamics within the group.

results.title: Tainá and the Amazon's Guardians - In Search of Blue Arrow
results.original_title: Tainá e os Guardiões da Amazônia - Em Busca da Flecha Azul
results.overview: In the story, the wise Master Aí is responsible for training young Tainá to one day become the Guardian of the Amazon. And in this adventure, she will meet special friends: Catu, Pepe, and Suri. Different and inseparable, the quartet embarks on a journey in search of the Blue Arrow, an ancestral amulet that will guide their path so that they can guard and protect the forest from a great evil that puts everyone in danger.

results.title: Tremor
results.overview: Nightmares of a detective

results.title: Eternal Flame
results.overview: One day they meet randomly on the street: João is unemployed, Clara works in the film industry as a production assistant. They were colleagues at film school. She invites him to participate in this film she’s working on. “Eternal Flame” it’s a melancholic comedy about the dynamics of a film crew and the growing pains of a young slacker. A homage to the family of Portuguese cinema and cinema itself

results.title: Sanity Cream
results.overview: A sleazy salesman tries to sell a mysterious product...

results.title: Tilda Swinton: The Wildcards
results.overview: A biographical documentary that explores the enigmatic actress's boundary-pushing career. It features rare archival footage and candid reflections from Swinton and industry peers—including Bill Murray, Helen Mirren, and Ralph Fiennes—tracing her journey from fringe theatre to international cinema.

results.title: Gioia
results.overview: At 15, Gioia, a Black teenager, leads a dull life at school. In the evenings, she gives free rein to her passion: Afro dance. When she shares this hobby with Amandine, a popular classmate, their two worlds collide.

results.title: Within Temptation Live at Hellfest 2025
results.overview: Lyrical flights of fancy, powerful riffs and electronic sounds – the Within Temptation concert is one of the highlights of Hellfest 2025. And hovering above it all is the incomparable voice of Sharon den Adel.  Anyone who claims metal isn't elegant has clearly never heard Within Temptation : First-class vocals, melodies that are both dark and catchy, and sophisticated imagery make them an exceptional phenomenon in extreme music.  And in 2025, Within Temptation will once again transform Hellfest into a musical bloodbath!  Setlist: "We Go to War", "Bleed Out", "In the Middle of the Night", "Angels", "Faster", "Paradise (What About Us?)", "Stand My Ground", "Wireless", "Supernova", "Don't Pray for Me", "Lost", "The Reckoning", "Ice Queen", "Our Solemn Hour", "Mother Earth"

results.title: A Light in the Harbor
results.overview: Miura, an aging ex-yakuza, develops an unexpected bond with Kota, a blind orphan. As they grow closer like family, Miura learns that Kota's sight can be restored with surgery. Determined to help, he steals money from his former yakuza group and leaves it for Kota before turning himself in. 12 years later, Miura is released from prison. Upon learning this, the yakuza plans to kill both Miura and Kota. Miura sacrifices himself to protect Kota, and...

results.title: In Thanks We Trust
results.overview: A unique journey by Ukrainian military artists who embarked on an extensive tour of the United States. In 102 days, they covered over 30,000 kilometers, performed in 69 cities, and held 260 concerts — from intimate street performances to prestigious stages at Congress, Carnegie Hall, and TEDx.

results.title: The Comic Shop
results.overview: A comic shop owner, thinks his dreams are over—until he meets Brandon. Together with his friend Alex, they reinvent their passions and save each other.

results.title: When Afternoon Falls
results.overview: Maca is a 16-year-old girl, who is reserved and inexperienced in love. She and Ana meet with the excuse of returning a sweater that Ana had previously lent her. In a daily afternoon they will experience the vulnerability of what it means to fall in love for the first time.

results.title: Screw Year's Eve
results.overview: A group of friends decide to ring in the New Year at an extravagant 80s-themed party hosted in a remote warehouse at the edge of town. As the night unfolds, they quickly realize they are not alone. Trapped in a labyrinth of neon lights and retro nostalgia, they find themselves hunted by a merciless killer hell-bent on making sure they never see another year.

results.title: Heroes of Jokes
results.overview: What happens if Vasily Ivanovich, Teshcha, Chukcha and Novyi Russkiy end up in modern Moscow? The naive provincial Petya learned the answer to this question by accidentally reviving the characters from his favorite collection of jokes. Now he will have to figure out how to bring them back to their world. After all, if Petya doesn’t make it in time, the jokes will disappear from people’s memories forever…
